fit_coupon.note: PRINT FIRST (done). Hole sizes are tuned to it.

feeder_base.note: v3. Upright, 15% gyroid, 4 walls, 5 top layers, ~19 h. Tree supports only under the card-clear sensor pocket.

raw_tower.note: Upright, 3 walls. Magnet in position 1 (front), south pole down.

single_tower.note: Single-sleeved cards (inside 92.5 x 67.5). Magnet in position 2 (back).

double_tower.note: Double-sleeved cards (inside 93.5 x 68.5). Magnets in both positions.

gate_plate.note: Foot down. Glue a 1.5 mm silicone pad strip under the foot. Fits all three towers.

feed_roller.note: On its end, 100% infill. Three 16 ID x 3.5 O-rings.

exit_roller.note: On its end, 100% infill. Two 16 ID x 3.5 O-rings each (one is the pressure roller).

pressure_bridge.note: Beam down, no supports. 2 x M3 x 10 into the post-top inserts.

stack_weight.note: Fill the pocket with about 50 g (2 oz) of coins or nuts.

fin.note: Half of them mirrored. On its side, 0.12 mm layers. 3 x 3 mm silicone square in the face pocket.

track_pulley_idler.note: Axis vertical, 0.12 mm layers, 100% infill. 2 x 685ZZ each.

track_pulley_drive.note: Hub down, 0.12 mm layers, 100% infill. M3 nut + M3 x 4 grub.

motor_standoff.note: On a side wall, 5 walls (printed on plate 1).

scan_floor.note: Top face DOWN on the smooth side of the plate.

hood.note: Upright, tongue on top. Tree supports under the tunnel, pads and LED ledges.

sheen_cap.note: Back face down. 50 mm piece of the COB strip inside.

camera_plate.note: Tabs up. Camera connector faces LEFT (hopper side).

bin_side_back.note: On its outer face, tree supports under the hinge knuckles and servo bracket.

door.note: Top face DOWN on the smooth side, tree supports under the barrels and lever.

tie_bar.note: Floor plate face DOWN on the smooth side.

back_panel.note: Outside face down. Covers a bin module's back window.

back_panel_hub.note: Outside face down. Bin module 2's panel: carries the bin hub boards.

bin.note: Open side up, 2 walls, 10% infill. ~5 h each.

end_ramp.note: Ramp face DOWN on the smooth side, tree supports under the flange.

channel_cover.note: On its back. Clips over the back wire channel.

screen_cradle.note: Face down. 4 M3 inserts in the ears.

pod_cover.note: Back face down, tree supports for the GoPro standoff.

mount_wall.note: Screen mount across the hopper/scanner gap on the front walls.
